mapper.sql: t.id, t.app_name, t.name, t.address_type, t.address_list, t.access_token, t.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xxl_job_group t ORDER BY t.app_name, t.name, t.id ASC
SELECT FROM xxl_job_group t WHERE t.address_type = #{addressType} ORDER BY t.app_name, t.name, t.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_job_group ( app_name, title, address_type, address_list, update_time) values ( #{appname}, #{title}, #{addressType}, #{addressList}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_job_group SET name = #{name}, address_type = #{addressType}, address_list = #{addressList}, access_token = #{accessToken}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql:
FROM xxl_job_group t
AND t.app_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{appname}), '%')
AND t.name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{name}), '%')
